snippet.title: Marathon - Season 2 Gameplay Trailer | PS5 & PC Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/JP9200-PPSA24487_00-MARBUNDLE0000003

Darkness descends as Tau Ceti IV fights back. Season 2 is live now. 
  
Check out the new season in Marathon’s Open Play Week from June 2 to June 9. 
  
Season 2 brings a fresh start where everyone can explore what’s new and chart their path through the season together. 
  
Featuring the new map Night Marsh, a new defensive Runner shell: Sentinel, new ways to upgrade your Runner shell to fit your playstyle, new weapons, and more. 
  
Explore the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV, scavenging valuable loot in a high-stakes survival first person shooter from the creators of Halo and Destiny.
 
Infiltrate the dark sci-fi world of Marathon filled with rival players, enemy forces, and unpredictable dangers. Scavenge its maps alone or with a crew, then fight your way to extraction in tense, high-stakes PVP and PVE battles.

#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #marathon
